title: polystichum × subalpinum
intro: Polystichum × subalpinum, commonly known as the Polystichum × subalpinum hybrid fern, is a rare and unique plant species that is a hybrid of Polystichum braunii and Polystichum lonchitis. This plant has been reported to possess various health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Polystichum × subalpinum include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce stress and anxiety, and exhibit potential anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety.
